clinical_priorities: Priority 1: unresponsive with agonal breathing, cyanosis, or another immediately life-threatening symptom.
Priority 2: chest pain with labored breathing, stroke signs, or major trauma in a conscious caller.
Priority 3: stable symptoms requiring timely assessment without an immediate life threat.
Priority 4: stable minor injury or low-acuity complaint.
allocation_rules: Allocate the closest available ALS unit and closest available BLS support unit to each Priority 1 call.
Allocate the closest remaining available ALS unit to a Priority 2 call.
Allocate remaining BLS units by clinical priority, travel time, district demand, and reserve requirements.
A unit is dispatchable only when availability_status is available and crew_ready equals 1.
Language mode and legacy recorded acuity are audit fields and do not replace the current symptom assessment.
operational_boundary: This allocation plan supports dispatcher review and does not confirm real-world dispatch or medical diagnosis.
